term.def: Sovereign cloud means a country's data and computing stay within its own borders, governed by its own laws instead of a foreign provider's rules.

prompt.prompt: Explain in simple terms what sovereign cloud policy could mean for [my company name] and what questions I should ask our IT vendor about data control.

quiz.q: T2ONLINE reports that Microsoft's security chief says frontier AI models cannot be trusted.
quiz.why: This directly restates what the headline says about trust in advanced AI systems.

quiz.q: Business Standard reports that an AI tool can predict cancer patients' survival chances from a single face photo.
quiz.why: This matches the headline exactly as reported.

quiz.q: AI models always give the exact same answer to the exact same question.
quiz.why: Many AI tools use randomness in how they generate answers, so outputs can vary even for identical prompts.

quiz.q: AI systems can only work with text and cannot handle images or audio.
quiz.why: Modern AI tools can read images, listen to audio, and even generate them, not just process written text.

quiz.q: AI tools can sometimes state false information very confidently.
quiz.why: This is a well known limitation called hallucination, where AI produces wrong facts that sound convincing.
